summary: Verses AI Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the resignation of President and COO James Hendrickson due to disagreements over compensation practices, including non-payment of wages. Concurrently, the company announced a strategic pivot: discontinuation of all AI R&D activities to pursue alternative business opportunities. No financial terms were disclosed. The board determined the shift is in shareholders' best interests given limited capital and market conditions. No advisors were named. Filing is equivalent to a US strategic review announcement. Watch for potential sale, merger, or liquidation as the company exits its core business.
